text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mhm, working hard, I see! Trainer <username>, <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Here's some refreshments from me! Ice-cold 
drinks straight from the cooler box!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, I set up a pop-up sauna over there! 
Hammocks are ready, and I've already 
booked a celebrity masseuse!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your skills are progressing splendidly! I 
look forward to seeing where the future 
takes you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that goes for everyone else as 
well! Please use it without hesitation and 
recharge your vigor!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I look forward to all your future 
success!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that goes for everyone else as 
well! Please use it without hesitation and 
recharge your vigor!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your skills are growing by leaps and 
bounds! Sharpen yourself against your 
rivals, and I anticipate another 
magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that goes for everyone else as 
well! Please use it without hesitation and 
recharge your vigor!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your achievements make my heart race with 
excitement! Keep charging full speed ahead 
toward your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that goes for everyone else as 
well! Please use it without hesitation and 
recharge your vigor!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In the annals of this academy... you are 
about to leave a monumental footprint. Go 
forth and continue forging your own 
legend!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that goes for everyone else as 
well! Please use it without hesitation and 
recharge your vigor!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Have you noticed? There are students 
entering the academy who look up to you! 
Please, keep running so they have a goal 
to strive toward!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that goes for everyone else as 
well! Please use it without hesitation and 
recharge your vigor!
